messages:
alex: Quick heads-up  we pushed a small community release: redwood-model-adapters v0.2.1 is live on GitHub and PyPI. Lightweight adapters for T5 and Flan variants + a compatibility shim for legacy checkpoints. :sparkles:

release-bot: Published: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-model-adapters/releases/tag/v0.2.1 

mina: This is great for community contributors. What's the backwards-compat story for people on older checkpoints?

alex: The compat shim auto-detects common older checkpoint layouts and rewrites the weight keys. For a handful of edge-cases you still need the conversion CLI (one-off). Migration docs included.

ci-bot: CI: tag v0.2.1 build 9012  all checks passed  integration tests: adapter-load, conversion-cli  passed.

dave: Security note: tightened import validation to prevent path traversal when loading local checkpoints. No CVE required but please rotate tokens if you used the experimental registry helper.

docs: Docs updated: adapter-usage.md + migration.md. Added a short example and troubleshooting tips.

sara: Marketing/community ask: can we get a 2-line blurb about who this helps? I'll use it for the forum and the newsletter.

mina: Copyable blurb: "redwood-model-adapters v0.2.1 makes it easier to run T5/Flan variants with Redwood runtimes and saves engineering time on model conversion. See migration notes if you're using legacy checkpoints."

alex: Quick usage snippet you can paste into docs: 
```
from redwood_adapters import load_adapter
mdl = load_adapter('t5-small', checkpoint='path/to/checkpoint')
out = mdl.generate('Translate to french: Hello world')
print(out)
```

ops-bot: Release assets: sdist, wheel, and a small conversion binary. Docker test images pushed to ghcr.io/redwood-inference/redwood-model-adapters:0.2.1

mina: Community event: planning a short AMA next Friday (30 min) for maintainers and early adopters. Would love 2 volunteers to demo conversion CLI and adapter introspection.

sara: I can present the adapter introspection slide. Alex can you demo the conversion CLI traces?

alex: Yep, I'll demo conversion + fallback behavior.

ci-bot: Note: we included a "known issues" section: quantized checkpoint edge-case where key patterns differ by runtime. Workaround documented.

dave: Added security tracking ticket INF-4899 for follow-ups.

mina: I'll draft the forum post and tweet thread; aiming to post at 11am PT tomorrow. Tagging maintainers: @alex @sara @dave

ops-bot: Reminder: schedule maintenance window for the experimental registry token rotation (if teams upgraded).

alex: Thanks all  nice incremental release. Appreciate the quick reviews. :tada:
